zh.summary: 先記住一句：SMB 的共享名稱是檔案分享入口；看得到入口、能列出內容、能讀檔、能修改，要分開確認。

sections.heading: SMB 是什麼？
paragraphs: SMB（Server Message Block）是網路檔案分享協定，讓電腦存取另一台伺服器上的檔案。Windows 常用它；Linux 的 Samba 與許多 NAS 也能提供 SMB 服務。

例如合成路徑 \\fileserver\Training\readme.txt：
- fileserver 是伺服器名稱。
- Training 是共享名稱，也就是管理者開放的分享入口。
- readme.txt 是入口下的檔案。

SMB 列舉就是查詢共享名稱、類型與註解；在允許的條件下，也能查看共享內的目錄與檔案資訊。
[Microsoft SMB 概覽](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/storage/file-server/file-server-smb-overview)

sections.heading: 從連線到讀檔，經過哪些確認？
paragraphs:
先分成四件事：
- 找到服務：直接透過 TCP 傳輸的 SMB 常用 445 埠。埠有回應是入口線索，再由協定回應確認服務。
- 協商通訊方式：雙方協商支援的 SMB 版本與能力。
- 確認使用身分：建立工作階段，依設定完成身分驗證。
- 檢查操作權限：連到指定共享，再依每次請求判斷能否列目錄、讀檔或修改。

「誰在操作」與「允許做什麼」是兩個問題。匿名、Guest 與具名帳號也不是同一種身分，紀錄時要分清楚。
[SMB over TCP](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-server/networking/direct-hosting-of-smb-over-tcpip)

sections.heading: 工具查到的資訊，要怎麼讀？
paragraphs: Windows 可透過相關管理介面查共享；Samba 的 smbclient 則能查詢共享、連線及操作檔案。

例如 smbclient 的 -L 用來查伺服器提供的服務；連進某個共享後，列目錄與下載是另外的操作。取得哪些資訊，仍取決於查詢方式、身分與伺服器設定。
[Samba 官方手冊](https://www.samba.org/samba/docs/current/man-html/smbclient.1.html)

Microsoft 的 NetShareEnum 也能查共享資訊：Level 0 回傳名稱，Level 1 再包含類型與註解。這些層級描述「查哪些欄位」，不代表匿名一定能查詢。
[NetShareEnum](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/lmshare/nf-lmshare-netshareenum)

sections.heading: 用一個合成案例串起來
paragraphs:
以下是假想的授權實驗室紀錄，沒有執行真實查詢。使用同一個測試帳號 labuser，目標與操作已事先約定：
- 查共享清單：取得 Training 與 Finance 名稱。
- 列出 Training 目錄：看見 readme.txt。
- 讀取 Training\readme.txt：成功取得合成測試內容。
- 讀取約定的 Finance\test.txt：收到 ACCESS_DENIED。
- 修改、上傳與刪除：本次未測試。
可以這樣記：labuser 查到了兩個共享名稱，並讀取 Training 的指定測試檔。Finance\test.txt 的這次讀取請求遭拒；原因與其他操作權限另行查核。
單一檔案的拒絕回應，只能先描述這次請求，不能直接推論整個共享都不能讀，或所有人都沒有權限。

sections.heading: 共享權限與檔案權限，怎麼一起看？
paragraphs:
在使用 NTFS 的 Windows 檔案伺服器上，透過網路存取檔案時，要一起檢查：
- 共享權限：分享入口允許哪些網路存取。
- NTFS 權限：檔案系統對特定資料夾或檔案的存取規則。
例如共享入口允許讀取，但指定檔案的有效權限未允許該帳號讀取，這次讀檔仍會受限。群組成員、繼承與拒絕規則也要一起核對。

ACCESS_DENIED 的原因也可能涉及身分驗證或 SMB 安全政策。先確認失敗發生在哪一步，再查完整回應、身分與日誌。
[Microsoft 存取拒絕排查](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-client/networking/access-denied-access-smb-file-share)

ABE（Access-Based Enumeration，依存取權限列舉）可依權限調整共享內檔案與資料夾的顯示。它處理可見性；實際讀寫仍由存取控制判定。
[共享內的列舉設定](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/smbshare/set-smbshare?view=windowsserver2025-ps)

sections.heading: 防護與證據怎麼做？
paragraphs: 限制哪些網路與身分需要使用 SMB，依工作需求設定共享及檔案權限，維護受支援版本與更新，並定期查核異常登入和檔案操作。

傳輸保護也要分清楚：
- SMB Signing（簽署）：協助驗證訊息完整性，偵測傳輸途中遭竄改。
- SMB Encryption（加密）：保護傳輸內容的機密性。

實際是否使用、是否強制，取決於版本、協商結果與有效政策。使用加密連線後，檔案存取仍要通過權限檢查。
[SMB 簽署](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/storage/file-server/smb-signing-overview)｜[SMB 加密與安全](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/storage/file-server/smb-security)
證據記下時間、目標、身分、共享與完整路徑、操作、協定／保護條件及原始回應。練習只使用授權環境與合成檔案。

en.summary: An SMB share name is an entry point for file sharing. Check visibility, directory listings, reads, and modifications separately.

sections.heading: What is SMB?
paragraphs: SMB (Server Message Block) is a network file-sharing protocol. It lets a computer access files on another server. Windows commonly uses it; Samba on Linux and many NAS devices also provide SMB services.

Take the made-up path \\fileserver\Training\readme.txt:
• fileserver is the server name.
• Training is the share name—the entry point the administrator exposes.
• readme.txt is a file beneath that entry point.

SMB enumeration includes querying share names, types, and comments. Where access permits, it can also reveal directory and file information within a share. [Microsoft SMB overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/storage/file-server/file-server-smb-overview)

sections.heading: What happens between connecting and reading a file?
paragraphs:
Separate four checks:
• Find the service: SMB directly over TCP commonly uses port 445. A responding port is an entry-point clue; confirm the service from its protocol response.
• Agree on communication: the client and server negotiate supported SMB versions and capabilities.
• Establish the identity: create a session and authenticate as required by the configuration.
• Check the action: connect to the specified share, then evaluate each request to list, read, or modify.

“Who is acting?” and “What are they allowed to do?” are separate questions. Anonymous, Guest, and named accounts are different identities; record which one was actually used. [SMB over TCP](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-server/networking/direct-hosting-of-smb-over-tcpip)

sections.heading: How do you read what a tool returns?
paragraphs: Windows provides management interfaces for querying shares. Samba’s smbclient can query shares, connect, and perform file operations.

For example, smbclient -L lists services offered by a server. Listing a directory or downloading a file after connecting to a share is a separate action. The information returned depends on the query, identity, and server settings. [Samba manual](https://www.samba.org/samba/docs/current/man-html/smbclient.1.html)

Microsoft’s NetShareEnum also retrieves share information. Level 0 returns names; Level 1 adds types and comments. These levels specify fields to return, not a guarantee of anonymous access. [NetShareEnum](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/lmshare/nf-lmshare-netshareenum)

sections.heading: Connect the ideas with a made-up example
paragraphs:
This is a synthetic authorized-lab record, not a query we ran. The same test account, labuser, is used throughout, and the target and actions have been agreed on:
• Query shares: receive Training and Finance.
• List Training: see readme.txt.
• Read Training\readme.txt: receive the synthetic test content.
• Read the agreed Finance\test.txt: receive ACCESS_DENIED.
• Modify, upload, and delete: not tested.

A useful record says: “labuser obtained two share names and read the specified Training test file. The request to read Finance\test.txt was denied. The cause and permissions for other actions need separate checks.”
A refusal for one file describes that request. It does not establish that the whole share is unreadable or that every user lacks access.

sections.heading: How do share and file permissions work together?
paragraphs:
On a Windows file server using NTFS, network file access requires checking both:
• Share permissions: access allowed through the network share.
• NTFS permissions: file-system rules for the particular folder or file.

For example, a share may allow reading while the file’s effective permissions do not allow that account to read it. The read remains restricted. Check group membership, inheritance, and deny rules as well.

ACCESS_DENIED can also involve authentication or SMB security policy. Identify the step that failed, then inspect the full reply, identity, and logs. [Microsoft access-denied troubleshooting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-client/networking/access-denied-access-smb-file-share)

ABE (Access-Based Enumeration) can change which files and folders appear inside a share based on permissions. It controls visibility; access controls still govern reading and writing. [Enumeration settings inside a share](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/smbshare/set-smbshare?view=windowsserver2025-ps)

sections.heading: How do you protect the service and record evidence?
paragraphs: Limit SMB to the networks and identities that need it. Set share and file permissions according to work requirements, maintain supported versions and updates, and review unusual sign-ins and file actions.

Keep transport protections distinct:
• SMB signing helps verify message integrity and detect tampering in transit.
• SMB encryption protects the confidentiality of traffic.

Whether protection is used or required depends on the version, negotiation, and effective policy. Encrypted connections still require file-access permission checks. [SMB signing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/storage/file-server/smb-signing-overview) · [SMB encryption and security](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/storage/file-server/smb-security)
Record the time, target, identity, share and full path, action, protocol and protection conditions, and raw reply. Practice only in authorized environments with synthetic files.
